newsitem.title: USA: Applied Imaging IPO terms revised.
newsitem.headline: Applied Imaging IPO terms revised.

text.p: The number of shares in Applied Imaging Inc's initial public offering has been raised to 2.5 million from 2.3 million, while the estimated price range has been lowered to $11 to $13, from a range of $14 to $16, according to underwriter Montgomery Securities.
The offering is tentatively scheduled to make its debut during the week of October 21. The proposed stock symbol is "AICX". ---New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
